title: MFFU (MyFundedFutures) rulebook: Builder 50K / 25K, Rapid EOD 50K, multiple accounts
method: 2026-11-17: re-read directly from MFFU's help center (help.myfundedfutures.com, 78 articles) and plan pages (myfundedfutures.com/plans/builder, /plans/rapid-eod): the sandbox proxy now reaches both. status: confirmed = MFFU's own page says it; conflict = MFFU pages disagree (the stricter value is used); unconfirmed = not on an MFFU page (search / third party / derived); interpretation = MFFU's words read the strict way. Built 2026-10-18 from search snippets.

price.note: plan page 2026-11-17: $153 list, code CLUB = 40% off any plan -> $91.80 (= the owner's price); guide also lists 30% off $107 and 40% off (2 uses) $92; new customers 50% off the first eval (the owner is not new)

reset_fee.note: no reset price published for one-time plans; a reset does not extend the account's date; check the dashboard

eval_expiry.note: 'no clock counting down on your eval' (How it works); the 7-day inactivity rule still applies

value.moves: only at the session close, up only, from the end-of-day balance high
value.lock: stops at start balance + $100 ($50,100) and stays there
value.breach: real time: open (unrealized) losses count; equity at/below the floor at any moment fails the account

max_loss.note: guide: 'open equity losses are counted'; EOD article: 'if an open position dips your balance below the minimum, your evaluation attempt will fail' -> treat the floor as real time (open losses) though it only MOVES at the close

value.effect: trading paused for the rest of that session; the account stays open; resume next session

daily_loss_limit.note: whether open P&L counts and whether MFFU auto-flattens the open position at the limit is not stated (an MFFU blog says new positions are blocked and open positions stay unless the max loss is hit); treat the open loss as counting

consistency_eval.note: no consistency (best-day) rule in the Builder evaluation: one big day may pass it

min_trading_days_eval.note: CHANGED 2026-11-17 conflict -> confirmed: 1 day on Builder 25K/50K (guide, Traders Evaluation Simplified, consistency article)

value.mix: minis and micros count together (10 micros = 1 mini); orders above the limit are auto-rejected

max_contracts.note: minis + micros count together (10:1); 'orders that combine instruments may execute above the limit but this is not permitted ... can lead to an account breach' (cross-instrument policy)

scaling_plan.note: Builder has no scaling plan (third-party; only Pro has one)

value.sim_funded: allowed, unrestricted (Builder is the exception to the Tier-1 rule)
value.live: allowed but MFFU strongly advises against it; orders may not be honored

news_trading.note: Builder eval + sim funded: unrestricted (guide 'fully unrestricted'; news policy lists Builder Plans as unrestricted). Tier-1 = FOMC meetings, FOMC minutes, Employment Report (NFP), CPI; restricted accounts (Rapid sim funded, Pro sim funded) must have NO position and NO order (incl. limits) from 2 min before to 2 min after: 8:30 news -> flat by 8:28:00, reopen after 8:32:00

value.late_orders: forcing orders after 16:10 ET can disqualify the account

overnight_weekend.value: not allowed: intraday only; positions are closed by the platform at 16:10 ET; no weekend holds

value.hours: announced by MFFU before each holiday

holidays_early_close.note: CME half-days: MFFU does NOT auto-flatten at the early halt; 'failure to close the positions before the market closes will result in breaching of the account'

value.bots: allowed, set to your own parameters
value.live: automated trading on live accounts must follow CME rules

automation.note: nothing published about NinjaTrader ATM templates or Order Instruction Files specifically: allowed as automation under the fair-play rule; confirm with support in writing

copy_trading.value: ALLOWED across all account types (your OWN accounts; Tradesyncer / Tradovate group copier / any copier, at your own risk). Prohibited: copying ANOTHER trader, someone else trading your account, sharing a device with another trader, collaborating with others on identical or opposite strategies across unconnected accounts
copy_trading.note: CHANGED 2026-11-17 unconfirmed -> confirmed allowed (Copy Trading at MyFundedFutures, 2026-08-24)

vps_ip.note: no published VPS / IP rule; the same-device rule is about devices shared with another trader. Third-party (VPS sellers) say VPS is allowed

hedging.value: prohibited 'of any kind': a trader entering both buy and sell positions on the same underlying at the same time (NQ and MNQ = one underlying); unrelated assets allowed. Across accounts: not spelled out; 'of any kind' + 'a trader' -> treated as covering all of one person's MFFU accounts
hedging.note: the across-accounts reading is an interpretation (strict); the bot blocks it on every pair of accounts

price_limit_rule.value: no trading within 2% of a CME price limit on Sim Funded and Live accounts; equity overnight limit 7% -> trading suspended at a 5% move
price_limit_rule.note: CHANGED 2026-11-17 unconfirmed -> confirmed; applies to sim funded + live (not the eval)

value: multi-account mirroring for an unfair advantage
prohibited.note: profits from prohibited practices can be confiscated; passed evals reviewed; accounts terminated

value.rule: no trade for 7 consecutive calendar days -> the account could be closed (one-time-payment accounts, incl. sim funded); live: none
value.sim_funded_breach: forfeits ALL profits on the account
value.vacation: tell support before a break of more than 7 days
value.terms: Terms section 7 Dormant Accounts: 'If a User does not execute at least one (1) trade per seven (7) consecutive calendar day period, whether in an Evaluation Account or a Sim Trading Account, the Company may, in its sole discretion, deem the applicable account dormant, close it, and treat such closure as a breach of these Terms.' No warning step is promised.
value.counts: an EXECUTED (filled) trade; no page says a login or an unfilled order counts; no minimum size or hold time
value.keep_alive: a 1-micro trade only to stay active is not forbidden anywhere -> engine/keepalive.py (OFF by default): 1 MNQ, 15:33-15:48 ET, news-free, never opposite another account, hard 40-tick bracket, out in about 2 minutes (flat by 15:50)
value.terms_12_4: CAVEAT (skeptic review 2026-11-20): Terms 12.4 asks for 'consistency in position sizing, trade frequency, and overall risk exposure' and 12.4.2 names 'substantially smaller or larger numbers of positions than typical'. A weekly 1-micro, 2-minute trade on accounts that usually hold several micros for minutes could be read as inconsistent. The help article does not say when the 7 days start or what counts as a trade, and the Simulated Trader Agreement was not checked.
value.ask_support: NOT ASKED (owner 2026-11-20 16:30 ET: YES to the keep-alive on every MFFU account, no MFFU contact). It lands OFF; the owner switches it on himself (KEEPALIVE_ON.bat + the typed phrase KEEP ALIVE ON). Terms 12.4 (consistency in position size and trade frequency) is a business risk he accepted.
value.day_count: unknown whether MFFU counts the trading date or the calendar date, or from the purchase evening: the bot counts the ET calendar date of each FILLED entry, a new account from the day before its start (the start = day 1), and acts / warns on the last full session on or before last + 6

inactivity.note: Terms section 7 (updated 2026-10-09, read 2026-11-20): may close + count it as a breach; the one-time model article says 'could be closed'. The older article 11972075 is gone (404). Contact support before a break >7 days

commission_rt.note: CHANGED 2026-11-17 conflict -> confirmed: instrument list 'Total Cost Round Trip' MNQ $1.90, NQ $4.68

accounts.note: CHANGED 2026-11-17: max 10 active evaluations (was unknown); sim funded: up to 5 when only 25K/50K sizes, plan limits Builder 50K 1, Builder 25K 2, Rapid EOD 50K 3, Rapid EOD 25K 3; any 100K/150K -> 3 total. refund.value: fees fully earned once you trade

value.upgrade: instant: dashboard Stats > the passed eval > Upgrade; trade the same day (or a brief review, typically < 24 h; dxFeed same day)
value.funded_name: the sim-funded account has 'SIM' in its account name; same login credentials

start_balance.note: MFFU shows a sim-funded account from $0 (profit only): the 50K floor starts at -$2,000; NinjaTrader shows $50,000 + profit. Re-checked 2026-11-20.

value.lock: floor stops at +$100 above the start
value.after_first_payout: the max loss limit resets to $100 (floor = start + $100)

consistency.note: at payout time: the best day in the cycle <= 50% of the cycle's profit; not a breach, you just trade more days; resets after each approved payout

buffer.note: $1,600 with the $1,500-MLL add-on; must be cleared before a request

first_payout.value: $500 net profit above the $2,100 buffer (balance >= $2,600), >= 2 traded days in the cycle, 50% best day, and 48 h after the first sim-funded trade

payout_days_per_cycle.note: traded on at least 2 days in the current cycle; plan page says 'every 48 hours'

max_sim_payouts.note: after the 5th approved sim payout you move to a live account (Blue Row Capital)

breach.value: sim-funded max-loss breach ends the account; a new sim funded can be activated the next trading day at the earliest

sim_live_together.value: no: once live, active sim-funded accounts are placed DORMANT (not closed) and moved into the one live account; recently passed evals go dormant or the eval fee can be refunded; declining the live move is not possible; sim + live cannot be traded at the same time (Builder live trigger = 5th approved sim payout, the $100k sim cap, or risk team)

breach_cooldown_days.note: after a live breach: no sim funded trading, no new evals or resets for 21 days

owner_present.note: project rule (CLAUDE.md): never arm live trading; the owner must be present

live_move_other_accounts.value: other sim-funded accounts go dormant (not closed), merged into one live account; evals stay dormant; Rapid: all sim trading + new purchases suspended while live, up to $5,000 of sim profit to a Reserve, several Rapids combined into one live account; Builder: new evals/resets banned for 21 days after a live breach, otherwise purchases allowed 'unless communicated otherwise'; Builder balance handling and any way back to sim not stated (only a 'Path Back to Live' plan)
live_move_other_accounts.status: confirmed (dormant, Rapid rules) / likely (Builder purchases) / unknown (Builder balances, way back to sim)

automation_on_live.value: allowed (no HFT, nothing exploiting sim fills); live automated trading must follow CME rules; only the account owner may trade it, no shared devices; nothing public about unattended trading or a disclosure form

tax_forms.value: Rise payouts: the 1099 comes from Rise's tax department (Rise names 1099-NEC / 1099-K, only for individual US accounts, only money paid through Rise); Plaid/ACH payouts: MFFU mails its own 1099; a mixed year = likely TWO forms, each for what you received (your 80% / 90%), not MFFU's share; form box not stated (1099-NEC box 1 likely)
tax_forms.status: confirmed (who sends) / likely (two forms, net of the split) / unknown (box)

payouts_to_business.value: likely NO: Terms say all accounts must belong to the same verified individual and KYC is once per person; MFFU has no business-account article; Rise supports business payees in general but MFFU never says it accepts them

parallel_evals.value: up to 10 active evaluations at once (a 2nd Builder 50K eval while one runs is allowed); sim-funded: Builder 50K max 1, Builder 25K max 2, max 5 in all (3 with any 100K/150K); one live account. CONFLICT: the Builder 50K guide says 'Only one Sim Funded account may be active per user at any time on the Builder Plan'
parallel_evals.status: confirmed (10 evals, limits article) / conflict (Builder 50K guide wording)

independent_contractor.value: public Terms only say no partnership / agency / joint venture (s. 27.1); contractor wording is likely in the non-public Simulated Trader Agreement signed at the first payout via Rise -> treat payouts as self-employment income (Schedule C/SE)

builder_funded_count_conflict.value: Builder 50K guide (updated 2026-10-21): 'Only one Sim Funded account may be active per user at any time on the Builder Plan'; the limits article (2026-09-04) and the 25K guide: Builder 50K max 1 + Builder 25K max 2. Safest reading: 1 Builder 50K funded + 1 Builder 25K funded; a 3rd Builder funded may be refused.
